rationale: Three lenses ran: blind, edge-case (repo read access), and acceptance (against the ticket's 4 AC + the two user-confirmed scope decisions). Acceptance lens: all 4 criteria pass, scope decisions honored (DefaultModelsSelector stays router-free via defaultModelCandidates; router rows are checkable like regular models with no read-only special-casing). Edge-case lens traced every former use of the old single `models` variable and confirmed each was correctly split, hook deps are complete, and settingsToSelection/selectionToSettings/isModelAvailable key purely on `.value` with no router branching. Blind and edge-case both independently raised the same low-likelihood dedup-collision concern (a router and a model sharing `.value` would silently drop one entry in getChecklistModels); this is deferred, not blocking — the research backing this plan confirmed the current data model never produces that overlap (getLLMModels partitions router/model data with no overlap today), and the plan's own test ('keeps only the first entry when a model and router share the same value') already pins the chosen first-wins behavior deterministically rather than leaving it accidental. Blind lens's other observations (reversed design comment, router counted in the 'models available' label, pre-existing duplication between the component's useMemo and its load effect, no proof of downstream model-vs-router-id assumptions) are the deliberate, user-confirmed scope of this fix (routers checkable like regular models, persisted the same way) or pre-existing/cosmetic, not defects introduced by this diff — dismissed. Commit messages ('EPMCDME-15905: ...') match the required format. 0 patch/decision_needed findings, 1 defer, 4 dismiss.
